messages:
Zoe: hi team - Snowflake cert team pinged about our connector listing. they want a PrivateLink test, a Delta Live Tables compatibility note, and a short attestation for telemetry and retention. who can take ownership?
Kiran: I can take infra work for private-link + DLT compatibility. need network owners to open a sandbox private endpoint. also we'll need a small Delta table with compaction disabled to simulate heavy appends.
Elena: security asks: full threat model + KMS/HSM proof for customer-managed keys, plus confirmation that audit logs are exportable for 90 days. also need to check whether our connector writes any stable identifiers into Snow metadata.
Tom: from solutions: partner ask includes a one-page integration note for marketplace listing (how to configure, perms, runtime hints). marketing will want that by GA. also request a short video demo.
Aisha: partnerships side - Databricks wants a compatibility blurb for Delta Live Tables (DLT) and if our connector supports streaming ingestion into DLT. they also asked for a sponsored webinar slot if listing goes live.
Zoe: owners proposed: Kiran (infra + CI), Elena (security attestation), Tom (integration note + demo), Aisha (partner comms + webinar). timeline: mock-run in 12 business days, target cert in 4 weeks. any blockers?
Kiran: blocker: network approvals + NAT egress rules for the test VPCs. CI needs a route to spin up a small DBX cluster and a Snow test account that supports private link. can we get service test creds from partner teams?
Aisha: i reached out to Snow contact; they can seed a test private-link endpoint but need our peering CIDR and a contact. DBX said they can spin a light DLT job for us but need a workspace id and token. I'll collect creds by Tuesday.
Elena: also need legal review on the attestation wording. legal-bot, can you flag the certification template? :eyes:
legal-bot: created review request LR-2024-333, assigned to Legal (ETA 3 business days).
ci-runner: queued ephemeral job: `marketplace-cert-1745559999` - stages: provision-vpc, provision-snow-private-link, provision-dbx, run-ingest, run-queries, collect-artifacts. ETA 45m once infra ready.
Kiran: test plan high-level (added here so infra + eng-peeps can align):
 - provision private VPC with PrivateLink to Snow (smoke)
 - provision Databricks workspace + DLT job pointing at connector sink
 - ingest synthetic dataset (100k rows, 10% nested JSON)
 - run streaming delta inserts at 250 qps for 10 minutes
 - schema evolution: add new nested field, run backfill
 - vector-store roundtrip: embed -> store -> recall check against Pinecone/Qdrant test instance
 - telemetry export: verify 90d audit export + metrics around latency/cpu under load
 - KMS rotate: rotate CMK and assert historic data decrypts
Tom: adding product acceptance criteria:
 - DLT sink completes with no dropped records for 10m run
 - Snow private-link ingest rate >= 150 qps sustained
 - vector recall F1 >= 0.88 on stable seed dataset
 - no PII persisted in connector logs (PII-scan pass)
Elena: PII-scan note: we will run the PII redaction validator against the synthetic dataset and any partner-supplied samples. ensure samples are consented and residency-compliant.
Aisha: marketing note - we need logos, a short 2-line blurb from Snow/DBX if they want co-marketing. get approval before publishing.
Zoe: ok. action items:
 - Aisha: collect partner test creds + co-marketing permissions (due Tue)
 - Kiran: create infra PR + request network approval (due Wed)
